translations.web: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed; nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light.
translations.bsb: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be made known and brought to light.
translations.kjv: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
translations.asv: For nothing is hid, that shall not be made manifest; nor anything secret, that shall not be known and come to light.
